name: Bride Of Darkness
source:
Maria's plans for the future are completely ruined, as her parents unexpectedly marry her off. But an unwanted marriage is not the worst thing that awaits Maria, and her own life is at risk.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
父母突然安排她出嫁，Maria对未来的计划因此全盘落空。然而，一段不情愿的婚姻还不是等待着她的最糟糕的事，她自己的生命也正受到威胁。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111200/]Steam[/url]]
